description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart representing the distribution of items across topic categories, showing a total of five slices. The slices are labeled with percentages on the ring: an unlabeled light-blue slice at approximately 41.2%, a pink slice labeled “Person” at about 30.5%, a light-green slice labeled “Common” at about 14.9%, a pale-yellow slice labeled “Book” at about 9.1%, and a light-purple slice labeled “Sport” at about 4.3%. A legend titled “Topics” appears in the center of the donut, listing the categories with matching color swatches (including the unlabeled light-blue category), and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; visually, the segments appear arranged roughly from largest to smaller portions around the ring.
